title: get_object_vars($this) inside a class reads its private properties

ground_truth.statement: Calling get_object_vars($this) from inside MessageDto::jsonSerialize() reads all accessible properties including private promoted properties $type and $body, and includes them in the serialized JSON output.

notes: PHPStan 2.3.1 recognizes get_object_vars($this) as reading the class's private properties and stays clean. Mago 1.60.2 reports unused-property for both $type and $body. Default harness Psalm config runs with findUnusedCode="false" (if findUnusedCode="true" is enabled, Psalm 6.20.1 also reports UnusedProperty).
